# `SmartFollow`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

State of the smart-follow worker (firmware 9.75).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | INFERRED |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0 reports, StartSmartFollow @0x470f20 (64-bit build) |

New in firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0. The function name is SmartFollow. Its state printer reports stage and track_result. It is sent through the shared function-state envelope (the common formatter with the printer attached). Both stage and track_result are strings (firmware 9.75), mapped from internal integers: the stage is detecting after motion detection starts, starting_track once a target is found, tracking after the tracker has started, and idle otherwise; track_result is running after a successful tracker start and then takes the tracker's result when it ends (stopped, lost, init_failed, image_failed or mount_failed), after which the worker returns to detecting. The state enum is INFERRED. A receiver MUST NOT depend on seeing every transition. 64-bit build; the 32-bit build has an older worker with a different stage set.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"SmartFollow"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Function-state name; INFERRED to follow the shared function-state formatter. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`. [INFERRED] |
| `stage` | string | no | - | Worker stage, a string. Internal 1 gives detecting on the 64-bit build and waiting_target on the 32-bit build (firmware 9.75), 2 starting_track, 3 tracking, anything else idle. One of: `idle`, `detecting`, `starting_track`, `tracking`, `waiting_target`. [READ] |
| `track_result` | string | no | - | Outcome of the current track, a string. Internal 1 gives running, 2 stopped, 3 lost, 4 init_failed, 5 image_failed, 6 mount_failed; 0 or any other value gives idle. The tracker returns 4 for a failed image-centre query, 5 for a failed image fetch, 6 for a failed mount command, 3 for a lost target (including a timeout) and 2 for a stop request or a target static for over 5 minutes. When a track start fails, 4 is stored before detection resumes. One of: `running`, `lost`, `init_failed`, `mount_failed`, `image_failed`, `stopped`, `idle`. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, tracking - INFERRED envelope, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"Event":"SmartFollow","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"working","stage":"tracking","track_result":"running"}
```
